subject: Handoff: ClearGrove tenant setup & API key plan
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Alex Moreno <alex@cleargrove.com>
Date: Sun, 27 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Handoff: ClearGrove tenant setup & API key plan

Hi team,

This is the formal CS -> Implementation handoff for ClearGrove (HubSpot deal HG-2027-1098). Quick context: ClearGrove signed the Dedicated plan (monthly commit), wants production-ready tenant in staged rollout, and is sensitive about admin access and key rotation.

Summary of what CS has done so far:
- Completed kickoff and technical discovery (recorded notes linked below).
- Confirmed primary admin: Alex Moreno (alex@cleargrove.com).
- High-level requirements: private workspace, API key seeding for service account, role-based access (admins, engineering, analytics), SSO later in Q4.

Action items for Implementation team (priority order):
1) Create tenant/project: "cleargrove-prod" and a staging project "cleargrove-staging".
2) Seed one short-lived API key for onboarding and one service account credential stored in customer vault.
3) Create role matrix per attached org-access-template.csv (Admin, Developer, Viewer, Billing).
4) Schedule invite wave: admin invites + dev invites (we recommend staggered invites: admins 1 day before devs).
5) Validate telemetry endpoints and confirm retention settings (ClearGrove requires 13 month retention).

Attachments: ClearGrove-implementation-MAP.pdf (high-level milestones), org-access-template.csv (role matrix template).

Links: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1098 (deal), https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cMAP (kickoff notes).

Deadline: ClearGrove requested tenant access by EOD 2027-06-30. If that is tight, please call out what you need from them.

Thanks — Monica

--
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0162

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Alex Moreno <alex@cleargrove.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Handoff: ClearGrove tenant setup & API key plan

Thanks Monica — and thanks Alex for looping in.

Irene / Neha: I can take point on provisioning. Quick questions to scope the work:
- For the "service account credential" — do we want a standard API key (scoped) or a short-lived bearer for the CI pipeline? Recommend: create a scoped service account key plus a rotation cadence entry in the MAP.
- Does ClearGrove want RBAC enforced via our Console or do they plan SCIM/SSO later (if SSO, we should flag any interim manual admin invites)?

Tentative plan:
- Tue 2027-06-29 morning: create cleargrove-staging and seed a scoped API key inside staging; invite Alex as Admin to staging.
- Tue 2027-06-29 afternoon: create cleargrove-prod (in tenant), seed service account artifact (marked for escrow).

Irene — can you confirm you have the privileged workflow to seed keys in the customer vault? If not, I will need Neha to step in.

Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
Implementation Program Manager, Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Alex Moreno <alex@cleargrove.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Handoff: ClearGrove tenant setup & API key plan

Jonas — confirmed, I have the workflow and will perform the key seeding. Plan below with exact times and asks from ClearGrove: 

Planned schedule (PST):
- 2027-06-29 09:30: create "cleargrove-staging" project, seed one onboarding API key (scoped: read+generate).
- 2027-06-29 13:00: create "cleargrove-prod" tenant, seed service-account key and upload to customer vault (label: CG-service-20270629).
- 2027-06-29 14:30: invite Alex Moreno (Admin) to both staging and prod; invite Priya Shah (Billing) to prod only.

Asks for ClearGrove (Alex / Priya) — please provide the following by EOD 2027-06-28 if possible:
- Email address for service account owner (for audit entries) — if you want the account tied to a person, provide that email; otherwise we will label as "cleargrove-service@cleargrove.com".
- Confirmation that retention 13 months is acceptable.
- Any restricted IP allowlist for admin console access (if yes, share CIDR list).

I'll attach the seeding confirmation record once done and share the seeded key fingerprint (never the raw key).

Attachments: org-access-template.csv (filled with suggested role assignments).

Irene

--
Irene Choi
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.com

From: Alex Moreno <alex@cleargrove.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Priya Shah <priya@cleargrove.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 15:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Handoff: ClearGrove tenant setup & API key plan

Thanks — this looks good and aligns with our timeline. Answers below: 
- Service account owner: priya@cleargrove.com (Priya Shah, Head of Platform). Please tie audit entries to that email.
- Retention: confirmed 13 months.
- No IP allowlist for now. We will revisit if we enable SSO.

We are available for the windows you proposed. Please proceed with the staging key first — we will run smoke tests and confirm before you seed prod.

Also: could you add a Note in the MAP documenting the billing contact (Priya) and the expected monthly commit start date (2027-07-01)? If you need any formal PO or signature artifact, Monica has the DocuSign link in the deal.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Alex
